title: Title and Lien Service Standards: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Payoff, Refund and Release Timelines
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** The payoff, refund and lien release timelines below are identical on all six tiers, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 through Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+.

| Standard | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Payoff quote honoured through | 10 calendar days after the quote date |
| Credit balance refunded automatically when at least | 1.00 USD |
| Automatic overpayment refund mailed within | 30 calendar days |
| Hold before lien release after payoff by personal check or ACH | 10 business days |
| Electronic lien released within | 3 business days |
| Paper title signed off and mailed within | 10 business days |

## Reading the standards

- The 10-day good-through period of a payoff quote is counted in calendar days after the quote date.
- A credit balance of exactly 1.00 dollar is at the automatic-refund threshold and is refunded within 30 calendar days; a credit balance of 0.99 dollar is refunded only on request.
- Business days are Monday through Friday excluding US federal holidays.
- The 3-day electronic and 10-day paper timelines are counted in business days and apply after the release becomes permissible.
